title: Survey on the Use of ICT Facilities in the University Library
intro: This questionnaire is part of a study on how students use the ICT facilities in the university library. Participation is voluntary and your answers will be kept confidential.
The questionnaire takes about ten minutes to complete.

items.text: How often do you visit the library?

sections.title: Section B: Access to ICT facilities
items: There are enough computers in the library for students.
I can find a free computer when I need one.

sections.title: Section C: Satisfaction
items: Library staff help me when I have a technical problem.
The electronic databases meet my study needs.

items.text: What would most improve the ICT facilities in the library?

closing: Thank you for taking part in this survey.
